slides.title: MANTLE TECH
rules: MANTLE SLIDE
Press slide while you mantle: over a car hood or low cover straight into a slide, gun up.
MANTLE MOMENTUM
Your forward speed carries over the obstacle. No hard stop.
MANTLE STEERING
Steer left or right, aim down sights or abort mid-mantle.

slides.title: SLIDE TECH
rules: SUPINE SLIDE
Double-tap crouch while sprinting: a longer, lower slide that ends on your back, gun forward.
PIPE CLIMB + SLIDE
Climb up or down pipes on buildings. Hold crouch as you slide into a vertical pipe for a fast drop.

slides.title: LEDGE TECH
rules: HANG SHIMMY
Move left or right while hanging from a ledge, then climb, drop or shoot.
HANG LEAN
Aim while hanging: lean and rotate a full 360 degrees.
CLIMBING JUMP
Jump in any direction from ledges, ladders and pipes.

slides.title: MOBILITY COURSE
rules: CHAIN IT
Sprint, slide, mantle, climb and prone all chain together. Keep your momentum.
TUTORIAL FIRST
Every course starts with a tutorial that teaches the moves step by step.
CLEAN BEATS FAST
A smooth route beats a fast run full of missed moves. Fix one section at a time.
